decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper, but the described architecture is BERT-based and contrastive, with downstream property prediction rather than explicit generation. It does show FM-like pretraining on millions of diverse mRNA sequences and transferable downstream use.
evidence_snippet: "three BERT-based encoders"; "fine-tune the full model on four labeled human datasets"; "trained mRNA-LM on millions of diverse mRNA sequences from several different species"; "unsupervised model was able to learn meaningful biology"; "various downstream tasks"
